objects.name: Grafana security advisory (AV26-710)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-710 Date: July 16, 2026 On July 15, 2026, Grafana published security advisories to address vulnerabilities in the following products: Grafana MCP Server – version 0.17.1 and prior Grafana Loki – version 3.7.0 and prior The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates. Grafana MCP server-side request forgery via X-Grafana-URL header Loki detected_fields query limits results in unbounded memory allocation Grafana Blog
